description_en: Calls ModifyBackupPolicy to modify the backup plan of an HBase cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyBackupPolicy更改HBase集群的备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun hbase modify-backup-policy --cluster-id hb-t4naqsay5gn0000 --preferred-backup-time 01:00-02:00 --preferred-backup-period Thursday --preferred-backup-start-time-utc 17:00Z --preferred-backup-end-time-utc 18:00Z --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The backup time range in the current time zone. The interval is 1 hour
parameters.help_zh: 当前时区的备份时间区间。间隔为1小时
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:
- Monday: performs backup every Monday.
- Tuesday: performs backup every Tuesday.
- Wednesday: performs backup every Wednesday.
- Thursday: performs backup every Thursday.
- Friday: performs backup every Friday.
- Saturday: performs backup every Saturday.
- Sunday: performs backup every Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。
- Monday：每周一进行备份
- Tuesday：每周二进行备份。
- Wednesday：每周三进行备份。
- Thursday： 每周四进行备份。
- Friday：每周五进行备份。
- Saturday： 每周六进行备份。
- Sunday：每周日进行备份
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en: The UTC time when the backup starts
parameters.name: preferred_backup_start_time_utc

parameters.help_en: The UTC time when the backup ends
parameters.name: preferred_backup_end_time_utc
